newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Caltex says Ampol below expectations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Caltex says Ampol below expectations.

text.p: Caltex Ltd said on Friday that its Ampol petroleum associate had traded below expectations in the third quarter and that this would mean Caltex's second half profitablity would be below that of the first half.
Caltex said that Ampol's results "were well below expectations mainly because of depressed petrol refiner margins caused by surplus fuel supply in the Asia-Pacific region."

"As it is expected that there will be a continuation of low petrol refiner margins caused by Asian refinery expansion, the outlook is for a reduction in profitability for the second half of 1996 compared to the first half of 1996," Caltex said.
Caltex's shares were down 15 cents at A$4.50 at 12.40 p.m. (0240 GMT).
